description: Frontend patient portal pages: Create patient portal UI with pages for viewing appointments, lab results, prescriptions, and requesting appointments. Add patient role guard and navigation. Follow existing page patterns from frontend/src/pages/patients/, frontend/src/pages/appointments/.
steps: Create PatientPortalDashboardPage.tsx (under 100 lines): overview showing upcoming appointments count, recent lab results count, active prescriptions count, with cards linking to detail pages

Create PatientAppointmentsPage.tsx (under 100 lines): table of patient's appointments (past and upcoming) with columns: date, time, doctor, department, status; includes 'Request Appointment' button opening modal
Create PatientLabResultsPage.tsx (under 100 lines): table of lab results with columns: test name, date, result value, reference range, status; sortable by date descending
Create PatientPrescriptionsPage.tsx (under 100 lines): list/cards of prescriptions grouped by encounter, showing: date, prescribing doctor, medications with dosage/frequency/duration/instructions

Create AppointmentRequestModal.tsx component (under 100 lines): form with fields: hospital selection (dropdown of hospitals where patient is registered), department, preferred date/time, reason for visit
Create usePatientPortal.ts hook (under 100 lines): wraps React Query calls to /api/v1/patient-portal/* endpoints, provides { appointments, labResults, prescriptions, requestAppointment mutation }
Extract table components if any page approaches 100 lines: PatientAppointmentsTable.tsx, PatientLabResultsTable.tsx, PrescriptionCard.tsx

Add routes to frontend/src/AppRoutes.tsx: /patient-portal (dashboard), /patient-portal/appointments, /patient-portal/lab-results, /patient-portal/prescriptions - all wrapped in PatientPortalRoute guard checking for Patient role

Create PatientPortalRoute.tsx guard component (under 100 lines): checks AuthContext for user, fetches user's memberships, verifies at least one membership has role='Patient', redirects to login or 'not authorized' page if no patient role found
Update frontend/src/components/layout/Header.tsx: add conditional 'Patient Portal' nav link visible only to users with Patient role
Update frontend/src/lib/api.ts: add methods getMyAppointments(), getMyLabResults(), getMyPrescriptions(), requestAppointment(data)
Update frontend/src/constants/routes.ts: add PATIENT_PORTAL_DASHBOARD, PATIENT_PORTAL_APPOINTMENTS, PATIENT_PORTAL_LAB_RESULTS, PATIENT_PORTAL_PRESCRIPTIONS route constants
Create patient-portal.config.ts (under 100 lines): configuration object for appointment status badges, lab result status indicators, prescription frequency display strings
Create patientPortal.types.ts (under 100 lines): TypeScript interfaces for PatientAppointment, PatientLabResult, PatientPrescription, AppointmentRequest
If any page/component exceeds 100 lines, split: extract sub-components to components/ subdirectory, extract hooks to hooks/ subdirectory, extract utilities to patient-portal.utils.ts
acceptance_criteria: Four patient portal pages exist: dashboard, appointments, lab results, prescriptions
All pages use components from frontend/src/components/ui/ - no raw HTML outside ui/
PatientPortalRoute guard checks for Patient role and redirects unauthorized users
usePatientPortal hook uses React Query (useQuery/useMutation) for all data fetching
All API calls go through frontend/src/lib/api.ts client - zero direct Supabase calls
All files are under 100 lines - components/hooks/utils extracted as needed
TypeScript strict mode compliance - all data shapes have interfaces in types file
Patient portal link appears in Header navigation for Patient role users only
Appointment request modal creates appointment with status='pending' and shows success toast
verification: Run frontend build: cd frontend && npm run build - must succeed with no TypeScript errors
Start frontend dev: cd frontend && npm run dev
Login as a patient user (user with Patient role membership at a hospital)
Navigate to /patient-portal - should see dashboard with summary cards
Navigate to /patient-portal/appointments - should see list of patient's appointments
Click 'Request Appointment' button - modal opens, fill form, submit - should create pending appointment and show success toast
Navigate to /patient-portal/lab-results - should see patient's lab results in table
Navigate to /patient-portal/prescriptions - should see patient's prescriptions grouped by encounter
Verify all files under frontend/src/pages/patientPortal/ are under 100 lines via: Get-Content <file> | Measure-Object -Line
Try accessing patient portal as non-patient user - should be redirected or see 'not authorized' message
